primary_target: 1X2 selected accuracy, distinct from all-match/exact-score/combination accuracy
test_interpretation: All available historical periods are retrospective and some labels influenced earlier refits; never call them new prospective proof. No retuning on test/audit.
goal_refit: every two calendar months, before predicting any result on the current date
model_selection: pooled validation log loss only; freeze selected model/calibration before applying the fixed 6 selective candidates

selective.ranking: prefer target80-qualified; otherwise target70plus-qualified; within tier maximize all-match coverage then cluster lower bound then stable ID
selective.future_certification: requires prospective locked predictions, verified results and enough samples; retrospective target success is not certification

goal_market_diagnostics.calibration: regularized Platt fitted on previous OOF only
goal_market_diagnostics.selection: minimum pooled validation binary log loss; include baseline controls
goal_market_diagnostics.qualification: report calibration, baseline delta and selective coverage; do not inherit 1X2 thresholds/accuracy
